newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Thailand's GS Capital Corp signs US$60 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's GS Capital Corp signs US$60 mln loan.

text.p: GS Capital Corporation Public Co Ltd (GSCC) has signed a US$60 million equivalent multi-currency transferable term loan facility in Bangkok on Friday, arranger Chase Manhattan (S.E.A.) Ltd said.
The borrower is a leasing company and provides automobile financing in Thailand.

The facility amount was increased to US$60 million from US$50 million due to oversubscription, the arranger said. It has a maturity of two years and pays a margin of 82.5 basis points over the Singapore Interbank Offered Rate.
Fourteen banks joined the arranger in the deal.
Co-arrangers are Bayerische Landesbank Singapore branch and Tokai Bank Hong Kong branch.
Lead managers are Bank of Nova Scotia Asia, Daiwa Bank, Royal Bank of Canada (Asia) and Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken Singapore branch.

Managers are Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena Singapore branch, Banque Francaise du Commerce Exterieur Singapore branch, CARIPLO Singapore branch, Fuji Bank, Gulf International Bank, Kredietbank Singapore branch, Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan BIBF and Sanwa Bank BIBF.
Chase Manhattan Asia is the agent.
